output: html_notebook

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(nflfastR)
library(nflreadr)
```

```{r}
records <- read.csv("../../data/processed/team_records.csv")
```

```{r}
division_success <- records %>% 
  mutate(division_win_pct = div_wins / (div_wins + div_losses + div_ties)) %>% 
  # correcting it to a 0-1 scale
  mutate(division_win_percentile = percent_rank(division_win_pct),
         division_win_percentile = division_win_percentile/max(division_win_percentile)) %>% 
  select(season, team, coach, offense, defense, div_wins, division_win_pct, division_win_percentile)
```

```{r}
write.csv(division_success, "../../data/processed/division_game_success.csv")
```
